title: Diff Coverage Report v1
description: Structured diff-coverage report produced by combining unit and integration coverage fragments and running a unified validation against the source tree.

success.description: True when validation passed with zero errors.

base_sha.description: Base commit SHA used for diff context (null when not provided).

tested_sha.description: Tested commit SHA used for diff context (null when not provided).

total_modules.description: Total number of source modules checked.

errors.description: Validation error messages (empty when success is true).

changed_files.description: Files changed between base_sha and tested_sha (only present when diff context is active).

empty_diff.description: True when the diff between base_sha and tested_sha is empty.

git_error.description: True when a git operation failed during diff computation.

fragments.description: Paths to the coverage fragments that were combined.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this report was generated.
